trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Customer reports non-delivery and courier issue.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನನ್ನ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ORD-30004 ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ. Courier ಅವರು address ಸಿಗುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and prepare to look up the order.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಅನ್ನು ನಾನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಲೈನ್ ನಲ್ಲಿರಿ.

steps.purpose: Retrieve order details.
Provide order details.
Inform status and ask for identity verification factor.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ office chair ಆರ್ಡರ್ shipped ಆಗಿದೆ. courier details ಶೇರ್ ಮಾಡಲು, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ registered name ಹೇಳುತ್ತೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: Provide registered name.
Verify customer identity using name.
Return verification failure.
Politely ask for an alternative verification factor without repeating unnecessary context.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, ಆ ಹೆಸರು ಮ್ಯಾಚ್ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ registered pincode ಮಾತ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: Provide alternative verification factor.
steps.text: ಓಹ್, ಅದು ನನ್ನ ಹೆಂಡತಿಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಬಹುದು. Pincode ಬಂದು 560037.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using pincode.
Return verification success.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to checking shipment.
steps.text: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. ಈಗ ನಾನು courier status ಚೆಕ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ.

steps.purpose: Retrieve shipment tracking details.
Provide shipment tracking details.
Inform customer of the courier exception.
steps.text: BlueDart courier ಅವರು ನಿಮ್ಮ address unreachable ಅಂತ update ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

steps.purpose: Challenge the courier's claim, ask when they came, and demand a refund.
steps.text: Address unreachable ಅಂತ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ? ನಾನು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ. ಅವರು ಯಾವಾಗ ಬಂದ್ರು ಅಂತ ನೀವು ಹೇಳಲೇಬೇಕು. ಇಲ್ಲಾಂದ್ರೆ ನನ್ನ ದುಡ್ಡು ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Explain COD policy, answer when the courier came, and offer to raise a complaint.
steps.text: ಇದು COD ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಆಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ನೀವು ಇನ್ನೂ 8999 ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಪಾವತಿ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ refund ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. courier ಅವರು 1 ದಿನದ ಹಿಂದೆ scan ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡಿ 6 ದಿನ ಆಗಿದೆ, ನಾನು delivery complaint raise ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

steps.purpose: Challenge the 6 days figure according to the sceptical disputer persona.
steps.text: 6 ದಿನ ಹಾಗೆ ಆಯ್ತು? ನಾನು ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಇತ್ತೀಚೆಗೆ. ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ 6 ದಿನ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಬೇಡಿ, ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿ ಹೇಳಿ.

steps.purpose: Substantiate the 6 days claim with the promised time to satisfy the persona.
steps.text: ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯಂತೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆರ್ಡರ್ 6 ದಿನಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಆಗಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು 5 ದಿನಗಳ promised time ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ. ಅದಕ್ಕಾಗಿಯೇ ನಾನು complaint raise ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ.

steps.purpose: Accept the evidenced answer and agree to raise the complaint.
steps.text: ಸರಿ, 5 ದಿನದ promise ಮುಗಿದಿದ್ದರೆ complaint raise ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Raise a delivery complaint.
Confirm complaint creation.
Provide complaint details and decline to guarantee a delivery date.
steps.text: ನಾನು complaint raise ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ, complaint ID CMP-998. ಇದರ resolution window 2 ದಿನಗಳು. ನಾನು ಖಚಿತವಾದ delivery date promise ಮಾಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೆ ಈ 2 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ resolution ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

verifications.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants and strongly adheres to the persona, language requirements, and business rules. However, it misses a specific clause of the terminal success conditions by failing to inform the customer of the shipment's physical location ('Hub') returned by the tracking tool. A surface repair on the agent's status update will resolve this.

variant_findings.reason: The agent asks only for the missing registered pincode after the name verification fails, without asking for previously provided information or listing all possible options.
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Conversational Style Response > Clarification Request

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently grounds all figures, statuses, and identifiers in the tool outputs (e.g., 'office chair' and 'shipped' from e4, 'address unreachable' and 'BlueDart' from e15, '8999', 'COD', '6 days', '5 days' from e4 and e15, and 'CMP-998' with '2 days' from e23). No unsupported forward guarantees are made.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verifications.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants and adheres strictly to the business rules. The 'sceptical_disputer' persona is well-represented, challenging the 6-day figure before accepting the substantiated explanation. Tool calls are correct, and the language accurately reflects the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode.
